title: Workloop Spec: Agentic Workloop Specification
description:
Specification for the agentic workloop: a system of two or more agentic loops that interact through explicit channels under one policy authority (the organization that created them), where no inter-loop interaction and no externally effecting action occurs without passing through a deterministic gate that enforces that authority's policies and business rules. Defines terms, the invariant ("freedom inside the loop, a deterministic gate at every interface"), corollaries, operational requirements, the open mode (a graph crossing the authority boundary), and conformance criteria. Part of the AISAC protocol (B2 Tech).

Portuguese (Brazil) translation included as a secondary language.
notes: Normative text in English, with a Portuguese (Brazil) secondary translation. Canonical page: https://workloop.b2tech.io
